changes: Replaced octagonal broadleaf polygons with smooth cupped elliptical leaf meshes and procedural vein/bump maps; increased fine-leaf crown density
Reduced near-camera vine leaves to 2.5–7cm and increased their count; reduced near lotus leaves again
Welded and smoothed higher-resolution displaced boulders instead of retaining flat face normals; removed large green moss overlaid rock masses
Added 48 staggered rear ledge boulders and 280 shoreline fern clumps to close straight empty ground gaps
Replaced broad sinusoidal moss patches with continuous 3D weathering, mineral and moss shaders on stone and wet rock; added continuous aged paint/wood variation
Changed the hall facade angle and portal placement, widened major columns and rebuilt the lower/upper carved friezes
Added three physically separated rafter tiers under all curved roof eaves
Replaced the picket-like waterfall with two connected cascades; calmed and neutralized the physical reflection surface
Added a depth-texture-driven near-field optical defocus pass over the real HDR scene render; bridge/tower/hall remain in focus and final frame synchronously reaches the default framebuffer
